messages:
incident-bot: PAGER -> elevated 5xx and timeout errors on /v1/stream in us-east-1. alert rule: inference_5xx_high_us-east-1 (>=4% over 5m). :rotating_light:
Priya (oncall): I'm on it. opening traces and checking recent deploys. any canaries?
Diego: there was a canary rollout of fp16-sparse model variant ~6m ago. infra metrics show sudden jitter in host-side latency and a spike in backend timeouts.
Mina: logs show repeated gRPC cancellations from the runtime: "kv_cache_miss_lock" happening under certain sequence-length batches. looks like a contention regress.
Priya (oncall): initiating mitigation: 1) pause canary rollout, 2) enable fallback routing to a stable model pool, 3) temporarily reduce max_batch_size to 32 for /v1/stream to reduce kernel memory pressure.
Zoe: routing change applied, traffic split 100% -> stable pool. batch size change pushed via config flag.
eng-sre-bot: rollout pause: fp16-sparse canary paused by Priya at 2766000205.
Samir: scaling up hot pool-2 by +1 GPU while we stabilize. autoscaler override done.
Diego: 5xx rate falling fast from 5.1% -> 1.8% in the last 4m. timeouts still occasional, looking into tail latency buckets.
Priya (oncall): customer-impact note: internal monitoring indicates ~3.4% of live sessions experienced errors; CS alerted with initial message.
Mina: repro on local perf rig: sequence length around 1024 triggers KV cache lock thrash when combining with prefix compression on fp16-sparse. marking as root-cause candidate.
Priya (oncall): moving to 2-hour handoff to Diego for post-incident follow-ups and dashboard work. leaving immediate monitoring to oncall.
Diego: will own. follow-ups: alert tuning, dashboard with drilldowns, and a postmortem doc. immediate dashboard needs: golden signals (error rate, p95 latency, requests/sec), GPU mem pressure, kernel queue length, KV cache hit/miss ratio, recent deploy overlay, and a drilldown panel linking to Jaeger traces and to CI job for the canary.
Zoe: drafting panel queries now. example PromQLs:
```
# error rate per route
sum(rate(redwood_inference_http_errors_total{code=~"5..",route=~"/v1/stream"}[5m])) by (route) / sum(rate(redwood_inference_http_requests_total{route=~"/v1/stream"}[5m])) by (route)

# P95 tail latency (ms) per route
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(redwood_inference_request_duration_seconds_bucket{route="/v1/stream"}[5m])) by (le)) * 1000

# kernel queue length
avg by (kernel, pool) (redwood_kernel_queue_length)
```
```
# minimal Grafana panel snippet for error rate
{"type":"timeseries","title":"5xx rate /v1/stream","targets":[{"expr":"sum(rate(redwood_inference_http_errors_total{code=~\"5..\",route=~\"/v1/stream\"}[5m])) / sum(rate(redwood_inference_http_requests_total{route=~\"/v1/stream\"}[5m]))"}]} 
```
Diego: alert tuning proposal: replace simple percentage threshold with combined rule: sustained error percentage AND absolute volume so we don't alert on small noisy routes. e.g.:
```
expr: (sum(increase(redwood_inference_http_errors_total{code=~"5..",route="/v1/stream"}[4m])) > 40) and ( (sum(rate(redwood_inference_http_requests_total{route="/v1/stream"}[5m])) by (route)) > 100 )
```
This should cut noise from low-volume bursts.
Priya (oncall): also recommend adding a short suppression window for deploys: ignore alerts for 90s following deploy start unless errors exceed a higher emergency threshold.
Mina: agreed. we should add a deploy-overlay to dashboards with clickable markers that open the CI job and commit. helps correlate quickly.
Samir: action item: review autoscaler headroom for critical routes. I'll add a metric for "burstable spare GPUs" and a panel to show available headroom in real time.
Diego: creating ticket INF-7710 "Incident dashboard: stream route golden signals + drilldowns" assigned to Zoe & Mina. due in 10d. link: https://tickets.example/INF-7710
Zoe: planning panels: overview row (golden signals), per-pool resource row, per-model variant row, drilldown row (traces/logs/deploy). will include a small table of recent errors with sample request IDs for quick copy-to-logs.
Eng-sre-bot: playbook snippet added to wiki: "oncall/inference/runbook#deploy-related-5xx" by Diego.
Diego: mapping owners: Diego -> postmortem + alert PR, Zoe -> Grafana dashboard prototype, Mina -> reproduce & runtime fix investigation, Samir -> autoscale/burst headroom. Priya -> customer comms follow-up.
Priya (oncall): handing off at 2766000325. Diego takes over. continuing to monitor for 30m. :wave:
Mina: I'll post reproduction logs and sample traces into INF-7710. include the perf harness trace that shows KV lock stack.
Zoe: I'll wire in Jaeger links for the trace drilldown and a templated Kibana query for logs by request_id.
Diego: once dashboard is up, we'll run a scheduled drill to validate drilldowns and suppression rules. recommend a 'synthetic canary spike' test.
eng-sre-bot: INCIDENT MITIGATED at 2766000388. current 5xx rate 0.6%.
Priya (oncall): thanks everyone. please add any additional notes to INF-7710 before Diego starts the postmortem.
